actor.description: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA is a CrowdStrike-tracked DPRK-nexus adversary associated with fraudulent remote IT-worker infiltration. CrowdStrike reports that the adversary uses AI-enhanced personas and front companies to obtain remote employment and generate revenue that is funneled to the North Korean regime.
actor.analyst_notes: Modeled as a vendor-specific named adversary, separate from the broader DPRK IT Worker Schemes ecosystem and from Contagious Interview.

attribution.assessment: CrowdStrike consistently describes FAMOUS CHOLLIMA as a DPRK-nexus adversary; its IT-worker revenue generation supports the North Korean regime.
attribution.analyst_notes: State-aligned is used instead of asserting a specific government unit.

motivations.description: CrowdStrike states that FAMOUS CHOLLIMA's IT-worker infiltration is primarily financially motivated and generates revenue for the North Korean regime.

relationships.description: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA is a named CrowdStrike adversary operating within the broader DPRK remote IT-worker revenue-generation ecosystem represented by the repository's scheme profile.
relationships.analyst_notes: Separates vendor-specific actor identity from the broad government scheme.

relationships.description: CrowdStrike tracking and community identifiers overlap with activity commonly described as Contagious Interview, but the two repository entities are not modeled as exact aliases.

diamond_model.capability: Fraudulent identities, AI-assisted personas, remote IT employment, insider access, and associated hands-on-keyboard activity.
diamond_model.infrastructure: Front companies, remote-work infrastructure, and identity/laptop-farm ecosystems described across DPRK IT-worker reporting.
diamond_model.victim: Technology companies and other employers targeted for fraudulent remote employment.
diamond_model.analyst_notes: Broad DPRK ecosystem infrastructure is not automatically attributed to every FAMOUS CHOLLIMA operation.

targets.selection_logic: Only source-explicit actor-specific targeting is structured.
targets.analyst_notes: CrowdStrike's 2026 technology report documents significant FAMOUS CHOLLIMA activity against technology companies.

sources.title: CrowdStrike 2026 Technology Threat Landscape Report
sources.analyst_notes: Current actor-specific reporting: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA conducted DPRK IT-worker infiltration and was primarily financially motivated.

sources.title: CrowdStrike 2025 Threat Hunting Report
sources.analyst_notes: Reports FAMOUS CHOLLIMA IT workers using generative AI throughout hiring and employment operations.

sources.title: Justice Department Announces Coordinated, Nationwide Actions to Combat North Korean Remote IT Workers' Illicit Revenue Generation Schemes
sources.analyst_notes: Background source for the broader DPRK IT-worker ecosystem; it does not itself name FAMOUS CHOLLIMA.

key_judgments.statement: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA is a distinct vendor-named DPRK-nexus adversary and should not be used as an exact alias for the broad DPRK IT Worker Schemes ecosystem.

gaps: Public vendor cluster boundaries between FAMOUS CHOLLIMA and Contagious Interview remain overlapping.
uncertainties: Government reporting describes the wider DPRK IT-worker scheme without necessarily using CrowdStrike's FAMOUS CHOLLIMA label.

free_text.executive_summary: FAMOUS CHOLLIMAはCrowdStrikeが追跡するDPRK-nexus Actor。AI等を用いた偽装身元でリモートIT職へ潜入し、北朝鮮政権へ収益を送る活動を主に追跡する。
free_text.history: CrowdStrikeは2024〜2026年にかけてFAMOUS CHOLLIMAのIT-worker/insider型活動の拡大を継続報告している。
free_text.capability_details: 偽身元・AI生成プロフィール・リモート就労・内部アクセスを組み合わせたIT-worker infiltration。
free_text.infrastructure_details: front company、identity ecosystem、remote-work環境など。広域DPRK schemeの要素を個別Actorへ自動帰属しない。
free_text.targeting_details: CrowdStrikeはtechnology sectorを中心に大規模な潜入活動を報告している。
free_text.additional_notes: DPRK IT Worker Schemesは上位ecosystemとして別profileで保持。Contagious Interviewとはoverlap関係として扱いexact aliasにはしない。
